title: Troubleshoot alarm 9973 incoming power fault on a Haas machine

context.subsystem: incoming power monitoring (Wye-Delta contactor and I/O PCB)
symptoms: alarm 9973 on screen and machine stops

subsystem.note: Named in the narration and the official description.

alarm_codes.note: Stated in the narration, the title card and the control banner.

components.note: Named in the narration or shown with labels on screen.

steps.title: Understand alarm 9973 and how the machine monitors incoming power
Power down safely before opening anything
Remove the covers and check the connections
Conclude brownout and stabilize the incoming power
Special cases: logged-only alarms and machines without the monitoring hardware

questions.question: The title card says 'Invalid power control state detected' while the YouTube title says 'Unstable incoming power'; which wording does the control use?
How long should the wait be? The video says to wait for the light, with no time.
What does arcing look like, and what is done if it is found? The video only says to check for it.
Who selects and installs the power conditioner, and to what specification? The video does not say.
The captions mention an upgrade to the software version shown on screen right after 'ignore the alarm'. Is the upgrade a second instruction or part of the ignore case?
Which alarm number is logged but not shown: 9973 or a different one? The caption reads 973.
